name: PostHog
tagline: Open-source product analytics, feature flags, and session replay

pricing.notes: PostHog Cloud free monthly allowances checked 19 Nov 2026: 1M analytics events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature-flag requests, then usage-based pricing (https://posthog.com/pricing). Self-hosting available; paid-plan features are Cloud-only per PostHog self-host docs.

projectLimits.notes: One project is free without billing. Additional projects require a payment method on file.
